sources.title: HeatTok: Enhancing Remote Sensing Image Understanding via ...
sources.snippet: HeatTok leverages thermodiffusion to generate object-level tokens that adhere to true boundaries. core component of MLLMs, the visual tokenizer is responsible for identifying basic visual elements from images and transforming them into model-processable token sequences. Its quality directly impacts the visual comprehension of the model.
